schema_grounding_notes: aggregate_clinical_significance / disease_clinical_significance: core values are 'benign', 'likely benign', 'uncertain significance', 'likely pathogenic', 'pathogenic', 'conflicting classifications of pathogenicity', 'risk factor', 'drug response' — all lowercase on disk; do NOT use abbreviations like VUS, LP, LB, P, B. High-count compound/extra values also present on disk: 'benign/likely benign' (64,981 rows), 'pathogenic/likely pathogenic' (39,700 rows), 'other' (1,526 rows), 'no classification for the single variant' (691 rows). submission_clinical_significance: same core set EXCEPT 'conflicting classifications of pathogenicity' does NOT appear — use 'conflicting data from submitters' instead; also includes 'other' (2,338 rows) and 'affects' (321 rows). Use aggregate_clinical_significance for variant-level queries, disease_clinical_significance for variant-disease pair queries, submission_clinical_significance for submitter-level queries

disease_master_table_clinvar exists on disk (29,648 rows) but is KG-only (exec_schema:false on all columns) — disease_name and disease_id are denormalised onto variant_disease_association_clinvar; route all exec disease queries to variant_disease_association_clinvar.variant_disease_name instead
variant_name stores HGVS notation; bare gene symbols (CFTR, BRCA1) should be routed to gene_symbol, NOT variant_name
rsid lives in variant_citation_clinvar; stored as bare numeric string WITHOUT 'rs' prefix (e.g. '28897696', not 'rs28897696'); strip 'rs' prefix from user input before matching
review_status values use full phrases with commas — do NOT abbreviate; 'reviewed by expert panel' is the highest-confidence tier (equivalent to 4 stars)

co_output_rules.reason: variant details are most useful when the gene context is shown
clinical significance is always paired with a disease/condition context
genomic coordinates require a genome assembly version for interpretation
rsID needs the HGVS name for full variant identification

filter_few_shot_examples.question: Is the variant rs397704705 pathogenic?
filter_few_shot_examples.note: variant pathogenicity query: rsid (WHERE filter on rs397704705), variant_name (co-output for full HGVS ID), aggregate_clinical_significance + aggregate_review_status (the answer — pathogenic/tier), gene_symbol + variant_disease_name (context). Genomic coordinates (chromosome/start/stop/chrom/pos/assembly) and origin_simple are IRRELEVANT — the user is asking about clinical interpretation, not genomic location.

filter_few_shot_examples.question: What pathogenic variants are in BRCA1?
filter_few_shot_examples.note: gene→variant pathogenicity query: gene_symbol (WHERE filter on BRCA1), aggregate_clinical_significance (WHERE filter on 'pathogenic'), variant_name + aggregate_review_status + variant_disease_name (SELECT outputs showing which variants and their disease context). Chromosomal coordinates and submission-level detail are IRRELEVANT — this is a gene-level pathogenicity question.

filter_few_shot_examples.question: What ClinVar variants are associated with hereditary breast and ovarian cancer syndrome?
filter_few_shot_examples.note: disease→variant query: variant_disease_name (WHERE filter on disease), variant_name + disease_clinical_significance + gene_symbol + aggregate_review_status (SELECT outputs showing variants, their significance for this disease, and gene context). Chromosomal coordinates, origin, variant_type, and submission details are IRRELEVANT — the focus is disease association and clinical interpretation.

filter_few_shot_examples.question: What variants are on chromosome 17 between positions 43000000 and 44000000?
filter_few_shot_examples.note: chromosomal location query: chromosome/chrom (WHERE filter on 17), pos (WHERE range filter), assembly (co-output — coordinates require genome assembly for interpretation), gene_symbol + variant_name (SELECT outputs identifying which variants are present). Clinical significance, disease associations, and submission details are NOT the focus — the user is asking about what variants exist at a locus.

filter_few_shot_examples.question: What germline variants in TP53 are in ClinVar?
filter_few_shot_examples.note: variant origin query: gene_symbol (WHERE filter on TP53), origin_simple (WHERE filter on 'germline'), variant_name + aggregate_clinical_significance + variant_disease_name (SELECT outputs showing the variants, their significance, and disease context). Chromosomal coordinates and submission detail are IRRELEVANT — the focus is origin-filtered gene variants and their clinical interpretation.

column_notes_override.variant_name: HGVS notation only; e.g. NM_007294.4(BRCA1):c.5266dupC — do NOT route bare gene symbols here
column_notes_override.aggregate_clinical_significance: enum — MUST be exact ClinVar phrase; 'uncertain significance' not 'VUS', 'pathogenic' not 'P'; see enum_columns for full list
column_notes_override.aggregate_review_status: star-equivalent review tier; 'reviewed by expert panel' = 4 stars (highest confidence)
column_notes_override.gene_symbol: HGNC official symbol — p53→TP53; bare gene symbols in queries should go here, NOT to variant_name
column_notes_override.disease_clinical_significance: enum — MUST be exact ClinVar phrase; 'uncertain significance' not 'VUS', 'pathogenic' not 'P'; see enum_columns for full list
column_notes_override.submission_clinical_significance: enum — MUST be exact ClinVar phrase; 'uncertain significance' not 'VUS', 'pathogenic' not 'P'; use 'conflicting data from submitters' (not 'conflicting classifications of pathogenicity') for submission-level conflicts; see enum_columns for full list
column_notes_override.submission_review_status: star-equivalent review tier; 'reviewed by expert panel' = 4 stars (highest confidence)
